tasks.title: Shoot the New Year caravan
tasks.summary: Come to the caravan, shoot it your way and post it.
tasks.brief:
What it is
The New Year caravan stops at Dostyk on 25 December. Come, feel the mood and show it to your followers the way only you can.

What to shoot
The truck and the lights, the people around it, your own reaction. A photo, a reel or a story: your choice.

Must have
The caravan is clearly visible in the frame.
Tag @cocacola_kz in the post or story.
Post it on the day, then send us the link.

Please avoid
Other drink brands in the frame.
Alcohol, smoking, swearing.
Music you have no right to use.

Good to know
A story link works for 24 hours only, so send it the same day. A day later the bot will ask how many people saw your story.
steps: Shoot it your way and post it.
Tag @cocacola_kz, then send us the link.

tasks.title: New Year post with Coca-Cola
tasks.summary: A New Year post in your own style with Coca-Cola in the frame.
tasks.brief:
What it is
One New Year reel or post in your own style. Coca-Cola is part of the moment, not an ad break.

Ideas
Decorating the tree with friends. Your family table. A gift you are wrapping. The first snow in your yard.

Must have
Coca-Cola is in the frame for at least a few seconds.
Tag @cocacola_kz.
Your own voice: say it the way you always do.

Please avoid
Other drink brands in the frame.
Alcohol, smoking, swearing.
Reading an ad text to the camera.

Bonus
The creator with the most views on this task gets extra coins. We count views four times: when you send the link, after 24 hours, after 7 days and after 14 days. The last number is the one that counts.
steps: Make a New Year reel or post with Coca-Cola in the frame.

tasks.title: New Year table reel
tasks.summary: Show your New Year table with Coca-Cola on it. One reel, your own style.
tasks.brief:
What it is
One reel about your New Year table: how you set it, what is on it, who sits at it. Coca-Cola stands on the table.

How it goes
You send us the draft first. We approve it or ask for a fix. You post only after the bot says Approved.

Must have
The table and the people, not only the bottle.
Coca-Cola is clearly visible.
Tag @cocacola_kz when you post.

Please avoid
Other drink brands on the table.
Alcohol in the frame.
Music you have no right to use.
steps: Post it after the bot says Approved.
Tag @cocacola_kz and send us the link.

events.title: New Year Caravan
events.description: The New Year caravan stops at Dostyk. Come, meet the team and other creators.
events.details:
Programme
18:00 Doors open, the creators' corner is by the main truck.
18:30 The caravan arrives and the lights go on.
19:00 Photo and video time: the best spots are kept free for the Hub.
20:00 Hot drinks and a small gift for everyone on the list.

How to find us
Dostyk, Almaty. Look for the team in red jackets next to the main truck.
Show your pass at the creators' corner.

Good to know
It is outdoors, so dress warmly.
You can bring one guest.
There is a task for this event: shoot the caravan and send the link the same day.

events.title: Creators New Year Party
events.description: Our own New Year party for the creators of the Hub. Music, food, gifts and the people you have only seen in the feed.
events.details:
Programme
19:00 Welcome drinks and a photo zone.
20:00 The team's toast and a look back at the year.
20:30 Awards for the top creators of December.
21:00 Music, food and gifts.

Where
Creators Loft, Almaty. The exact address comes from the bot two days before.
Show your pass at the door.

Good to know
Dress code: something festive, a touch of red is welcome.
The invitation is for you personally.
Phones are welcome: shoot and post as much as you like.
